delete_body: This removes the conversation from this machine.
unreachable: Can't reach the model server. Is Ollama running?
trimmed: Older messages were left out to fit the context window.
bind_warning: WARNING: the server is bound to {host}, not 127.0.0.1. Other machines may be able to reach it.
file_rejected: That file is outside the allowed folders.
file_too_large: That file is larger than the size limit.
file_unsupported: That file type is not supported.
file_corrupt: That file could not be read.
file_timeout: Reading that file took too long.
file_too_many_pages: That file has more pages than the limit.
file_too_long: That file is longer than the extract limit.
file_not_a_file: That path is not a file.
file_over_budget: {name} is {tokens} tokens. This chat can include {budget}.
file_index_unavailable: Indexing is not available yet. The file was not attached.
file_list_truncated: Only the first {count} entries are shown.
tools_unknown: Tool support for this model could not be confirmed, so tools stay off.
mcp_token_missing: The environment variable {name} is not set.
mcp_host_rejected: That MCP server host is not allowed.
mcp_https_required: That MCP server must use HTTPS.
mcp_connect_failed: Could not connect to the MCP server.
mcp_bad_arguments: Those tool arguments are not valid.
mcp_tools_off: Tools are off. No MCP server is enabled.
mcp_script_only: This server is disabled in config. The script connected anyway.
index_cli: Index an allowlisted folder, or score keyword search against a question file.
index_disabled: Indexing is off. Nothing was indexed.
index_no_folders: No folders are allowed, so nothing was indexed.
index_not_allowed: That folder is outside the allowed folders.
index_not_a_folder: That path is not a folder.
index_refused_files: That folder has {count} files. The limit is {limit}. Nothing was indexed.
index_refused_size: That folder is {size} MB. The limit is {limit} MB. Nothing was indexed.
index_chunk_limit: Stopped at {chunks} chunks. The limit is {limit}.
index_picker_unavailable: The folder window could not be opened.
index_picker_busy: The folder window is already open.
index_not_selected: Select a folder from the folder window first.
index_choose: Choose any folder this computer can read. Hidden files, excluded names, and links that leave the folder are skipped.
index_busy: A folder is already being indexed.
index_summary: {name}: {files} files, {chunks} chunks, {skipped} unchanged, {failed} failed, {removed} removed, {seconds}s, {size} bytes.
index_tables_note: CSV tables are split into row groups with the header repeated. Search finds them less reliably than prose.
index_fts_missing: This SQLite build has no FTS5, so folder search cannot run.
index_keyword_only: Only keyword search is available. Vector and hybrid search are not built yet.
index_eval_summary: Hit rate at {k}: {hits}/{questions} ({rate}). Mean retrieval {ms} ms. Wrote {output}.
index_eval_bad: The question file is not valid.
index_eval_folder: The question file needs an absolute folder path.
index_eval_empty: The question file has no questions.
index_eval_question: Each question needs an id, a question, and a list of expected file names.
index_eval_output: The question file needs an output path inside this project.
mcp_intro: Turn a server on to let the model use its tools. A token field is the name of an environment variable.
mcp_remove_body: This disconnects the server. It does not delete anything on the server itself.
mcp_name_taken: A server with that name already exists.
mcp_bad_name: Use a short name made of letters, numbers, dots, or dashes.
mcp_no_secret: Put the token in an environment variable. This form only accepts the variable's name.
mcp_save_failed: That server could not be saved.
mcp_disconnect_body: This signs out of the connector. It does not delete anything in that account.
mcp_oauth_done_body: Return to the chat. This window can be closed.
mcp_oauth_missing: That sign-in link is no longer valid.
mcp_client_missing: Set {client_id} and {client_secret}, then register {redirect} on that app.
